Input `accepted-fit` requires unavailable diagnostic-only `artifact.diagnostic.accepted-historical-gradient-fit.v1`; `field-domain`, `low-band`, and `high-band` also lack product providers. Output `refined-hypothesis` therefore cannot be reached from active native evidence.

Required input `eligibility` (`artifact.mask.extent-eligible-pixels.v1`) has no product provider, and `frozen-p3-rows` is review custody rather than product input. Product outputs `extent-field` and `field-set` have no active algorithmic consumer, so the extent substrate has neither a complete producer side nor a product sink.

Inputs `saliency` and `root-clusters` depend on `artifact.scalar-field.legacy-local-contrast-saliency-u8.v1` and `artifact.candidate-set.legacy-kmeans-public-clusters.v1`. That legacy saliency/cluster dependency cannot supply corrected text evidence, so `foreground-hypotheses` remains a legacy hypothesis output rather than active role input.

Input `working-raster` requires the prohibited resampled lattice `artifact.raster.working-srgb8-max-edge-224-lanczos3.v1`, not native pixels. Outputs `labels`, `region-graph`, and `source-representatives` therefore remain tied to the 224px discovery copy and cannot enter native product flow.

Input `accepted-fit` requires unavailable diagnostic-only `artifact.diagnostic.accepted-historical-gradient-fit.v1`, while `accepted-domain` and `occupied-midpoint-band` also lack product providers. Output `midpoint-nomination` therefore cannot carry a complete native product lineage.

Input `transition-paths` carries historical path observations and `midpoint-policy` is unavailable; the mechanism's recorded support is isolated-semantic only. Output `midpoint-nomination` is therefore diagnostic-only for this formulation and cannot establish the native-band lineage required by the replacement route.

Input `treatment` (`artifact.treatment.palette-working-exact-source.v1`) has no product provider, while `transition-paths` is historical path evidence. Outputs `publication-decision` and `exact-stop-path` are diagnostic publication/fallback records, not an admitted final treatment, so this formulation cannot close the product route.

Input `encoded-file` requires `artifact.source.encoded-opaque-image.v1`, so opacity must be asserted before decode instead of measured from generic encoded artwork. That invalid predecode opacity premise cannot safely authorize output `native-raster` (`artifact.raster.native-srgb8-opaque.v1`).

Inputs `root-clusters`, `local-saliency`, and `source-raster` independently elect complete role colors in output `legacy-role-election`. Independent role-by-role election bypasses the required joint candidate, relation, swap-legality, and treatment decision domain, so this result cannot be an admitted treatment.
Demoted because its current contract records publication custody only; proposed exact native-pixel admission replaces the missing product admission handoff.
Demoted because refusal and matte handling are non-palette historical behavior; successful product flow starts from the replacement decoder's explicit opacity decision.
Demoted because it verifies the completed contract after the product goal rather than transforming a product toward that goal.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Artwork Decode
proposedMechanisms.operation: Decode the encoded artwork once while preserving sourceImageId; emit an exact native sRGB8 raster only when every pixel is opaque, otherwise emit an explicit alpha refusal.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Raster Primitives
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure native intensity, OKLab samples, RGBXY coordinates, and morphology signals on the decoded raster.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Pixel Graph Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct the pinned native-pixel neighborhood graph and enumerate its boundary-aware adjacency pairs.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Edge Dissimilarity Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure every native graph edge with the pinned OKLab distance convention.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Component Local Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure exact component membership, area, bounds, shape, and local contrast.

proposedMechanisms.title: Deterministic Signed Affinity Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Transform edge dissimilarities into stable ordered attractive and repulsive affinities.

proposedMechanisms.title: Lifted Base Graph Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct the costed local base graph used by lifted multicut alternatives.

proposedMechanisms.title: Lifted Nonlocal Edge Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct bounded nonlocal edge pairs and costs from component and color relations.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Slic Partition
proposedMechanisms.operation: Partition the native pixel lattice with SLIC and retain exact pixel-to-region membership.

proposedMechanisms.title: Partition Native Region Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Validate a tagged partition and measure exact native members and region statistics.

proposedMechanisms.title: Region Boundary Statistics
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure region adjacency, contact lengths, border contact, and inter-region color distance.

proposedMechanisms.title: Region Color Proposal Extraction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Extract observed source colors and native-pixel witnesses from exact region memberships.

proposedMechanisms.title: Texture Distribution Segmentation
proposedMechanisms.operation: Segment native pixels by local texture-distribution distance under the measured noise scale.

proposedMechanisms.title: Rtv Structure Regionization
proposedMechanisms.operation: Extract provider-tagged native regions from relative-total-variation structure values.

proposedMechanisms.title: Tgv Field Regionization
proposedMechanisms.operation: Extract provider-tagged native regions from total-generalized-variation field values.

proposedMechanisms.title: Graph Trend Order0 Input Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct the node signal and order-zero incidence operator for graph trend filtering.

proposedMechanisms.title: Graph Trend Order0 Regionization
proposedMechanisms.operation: Extract constant fitted plateaus and residual evidence from an order-zero graph trend result.

proposedMechanisms.title: Fixed Soft Morphology Regionization
proposedMechanisms.operation: Threshold a fixed soft-morphology response under explicit polarity and reconnect native members.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Family Evidence Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Aggregate native family memberships, occupied colors, spread, masks, and observed-color statistics.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Family Component Graph Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Join exact components to color families and measure component adjacency and contacts.

proposedMechanisms.title: Archetypoid Observation Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct finite source-row observations and criterion columns for archetypoid and decision alternatives.

proposedMechanisms.title: Family Border Domain Proposal
proposedMechanisms.operation: Propose field domains from family support, component geometry, and border ownership.

proposedMechanisms.title: Robust Surface Domain Proposal
proposedMechanisms.operation: Convert robust inlier support into native-region field-domain proposals.

proposedMechanisms.title: Regularized Region Domain Proposal
proposedMechanisms.operation: Score provider-tagged native regions for low-complexity field support and exact stop paths.

proposedMechanisms.title: Hierarchy Domain Proposal
proposedMechanisms.operation: Extract field proposals from named hierarchy nodes while preserving node membership.

proposedMechanisms.title: Pixel Cue Domain Proposal
proposedMechanisms.operation: Aggregate per-pixel rank and surround cues over exact proposed field regions.

proposedMechanisms.title: Domain Evidence Election
proposedMechanisms.operation: Compare identified field proposals and explicitly accept one source domain or abstain.

proposedMechanisms.title: Accepted Domain Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure accepted-domain endpoints, geometry, support, and exact midpoint candidates.

proposedMechanisms.title: Source Color Proposal Extraction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Extract source-color proposals with saliency scores and native-pixel witnesses.

proposedMechanisms.title: Salient Mark Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure compactness, repetition, coherence, and per-mass evidence for salient marks.

proposedMechanisms.title: Text Cue Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure text-like shape, foreground polarity, and field contrast for role cues.

proposedMechanisms.title: Artwork Family Relation Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure artwork-family relationships between text, field, mark, and source-color evidence without electing roles.

proposedMechanisms.title: Treatment Swap Legality Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure which role-treatment swaps preserve artwork-family relations and exact-source obligations.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Witness Redemption
proposedMechanisms.operation: Redeem candidate colors only when each candidate retains an exact native-pixel witness and role-evidence binding.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Color Occupancy Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure the exact occupied native color set and aligned native-pixel witness counts for one raster identity.

proposedMechanisms.title: Exact Native Pixel Admission
proposedMechanisms.operation: Admit only redeemed candidate colors that are members of the measured native occupancy set with aligned pixel witnesses.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Transition Path Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct native-pixel transition paths through accepted field domains without synthesizing colors.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Band Local Endpoints
proposedMechanisms.operation: Extract exact native endpoint pairs from local bands along measured transition paths.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Spatial Midpoint Band
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure spatial midpoint bands between exact native endpoints and retain native midpoint witnesses.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Transition Stage Midpoint
proposedMechanisms.operation: Choose transition-stage midpoint candidates from the spatial band without leaving native colors.

proposedMechanisms.title: Native Transition Publication
proposedMechanisms.operation: Publish the witnessed native endpoint and midpoint transition sequence as a typed candidate path.

proposedMechanisms.title: Exact Source Pair Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct exact-source endpoint pairs with aligned native-pixel witnesses from published transitions.

proposedMechanisms.title: Ramp Excursion Measurement
proposedMechanisms.operation: Measure interpolation excursion for each exact-source pair and nominate source-color return candidates.

proposedMechanisms.title: Exact Path Election
proposedMechanisms.operation: Elect an exact-source path whose endpoints, optional stops, and native witnesses satisfy the measured excursion evidence.

proposedMechanisms.title: Joint treatment hypothesis construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Combine role-qualified witnesses, cue relations, candidate identities, and swap legality into joint hypotheses without assigning final role colors.

proposedMechanisms.title: Finite treatment factor construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Factor joint role hypotheses into a finite inspectable domain of role, relation, and source-identity assignments without minting a treatment.

proposedMechanisms.title: Swap-legal candidate-domain insertion
proposedMechanisms.operation: Insert only cue-supported, relation-preserving, swap-legal candidates into the finite factor domain.

proposedMechanisms.title: Structured Objective Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct a typed finite selection objective over the candidate domain and declared role obligations.

proposedMechanisms.title: Multicriteria Table Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct an oriented criterion table for every candidate in the finite treatment domain.

proposedMechanisms.title: Submodular Item Construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct coverage items and costs from the same candidate-domain criterion rows.

proposedMechanisms.title: Retained Subset Reification
proposedMechanisms.operation: Reify a retained candidate subset from an independently produced subset decision without minting candidates.

proposedMechanisms.title: Partial Preorder Linear Extension
proposedMechanisms.operation: Construct explicit linear extensions of a partial preorder while preserving incomparability witnesses.

proposedMechanisms.title: Retained Subset Ordering
proposedMechanisms.operation: Order only retained candidates using the declared linear extension and retained-subset identity.

proposedMechanisms.title: Treatment decision selection
proposedMechanisms.operation: Select a candidate hypothesis from the swap-legal finite domain using the bound decision evidence; emit a decision, not role colors.

proposedMechanisms.title: Selected-treatment role reification
proposedMechanisms.operation: Reify complete role and conditional gradient content only from the selected hypothesis and its exact candidate domain.

proposedMechanisms.title: Repair winner-input construction
proposedMechanisms.operation: Combine the selected treatment, exact native occupancy, and failed validation obligations into one identity-preserving repair input.

proposedMechanisms.title: Repair result role reification
proposedMechanisms.operation: Reify repaired ordinary and explicitly flat treatment results from the typed repair outcome without changing source or candidate identity.

proposedMechanisms.title: Exact-source infeasibility proof
proposedMechanisms.operation: Prove domain-specific exhaustion from the evaluated candidate domain, native occupied-color set, and zero-feasible selection evidence; metadata alone is insufficient.

proposedMechanisms.title: Exact-source treatment admission
proposedMechanisms.operation: Validate membership of every flat role color and every conditional gradient endpoint or stop in the exact native occupied-color set, attach native pixel witnesses, and emit one discriminated admitted-final treatment.

proposedMechanisms.title: Deterministic treatment repair
proposedMechanisms.operation: Apply the selected deterministic repair action to the winner input while preserving treatment, candidate, source-image, and provenance identities.

proposedMechanisms.title: Emergency Exact Source Admission
proposedMechanisms.operation: Emit the same discriminated admitted-final structure as emergency-flat only after exact-source infeasibility is proven and every emergency role color has an exact occupied native pixel witness.

proposedMechanisms.title: Ui Palette V3 Materializer
proposedMechanisms.operation: Map one already admitted ordinary flat, ordinary gradient, or emergency-flat discriminated treatment to v3 without selecting or admitting a treatment.
